<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/orders/{id}/release"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The ReleaseOrder use case. Enqueues each `Allocated` line as a work unit on wes-work-planning's process path for that line via `POST /paths/{pathId}/work-units`, sending the order's promise date as `cpt`, the order id as `reference`, and the line's `sku` and `giftWrap` (both already-optional fields on that endpoint — nothing in wes-work-planning changes for this context to exist).

The `workUnitId` is deterministic — `{orderId}-line-{lineNo}` — so a duplicate release is a detectable `409` upstream rather than a silently duplicated work unit.

**BR3 at the release boundary:** a ship-complete order releases NOTHING while any line is still `Pending` or `Backordered` (`409 ship-complete-blocked`). An order that allows partial shipment releases its allocated lines independently and reads `PartiallyReleased`.

Publishes `OrderLineReleased` per line, and `OrderReleased` once every line is released. A line that is not `Allocated` is never offered to the Supplier.
